scene.ko: 원어민 교사에게 수업에서 좋았던 점을 구체적으로 말하고, 작은 제안을 하나 덧붙인다.

lines.en: So, what did you think of today's lesson? Please be honest.
lines.ko: 그래서 오늘 수업 어떠셨어요? 솔직하게 말씀해 주세요.

lines.en: I thought it went really well. Your warm-up got the students' attention right away.
lines.ko: 정말 잘된 것 같아요. 도입 활동으로 바로 학생들 관심을 끌었어요.
alt: It went really well, I think. The warm-up caught the students' attention right away.

lines.en: Thanks. I was worried it was too easy.
Not at all. Even the shy students raised their hands.
lines.ko: 전혀요. 수줍음 많은 학생들도 손을 들었어요.
alt: No, it was just right. Even the quiet students raised their hands.

lines.en: That's great to hear. Was there anything I could improve?
lines.ko: 그 말 들으니 좋네요. 고칠 만한 점은 없었나요?

lines.en: Just one small thing. You could write the key words on the board. Some students find it hard to follow just by listening.
lines.ko: 작은 것 하나만요. 핵심 단어를 칠판에 써 주시면 좋겠어요. 듣기만 해서는 따라가기 힘들어하는 학생들이 있거든요.
alt: Maybe one thing. It might help to write the key words on the board. Some students have trouble following by listening alone.

lines.en: Good point. I'll try that next time.
lines.ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 다음에 그렇게 해 볼게요.

lines.en: Overall, it was a great lesson. The students really like you.
lines.ko: 전체적으로 정말 좋은 수업이었어요. 학생들이 선생님을 정말 좋아해요.
alt: All in all, it was a great class. The kids really like you.
